criterion_text: Historical GitOps acceptance remains usable through the explicit compatibility path, but structured/no-source Issues neither fall through to an implicit whole-branch archive nor snapshot unrelated Issue comments.

verifiers.summary:
lse\n' +
  '\n' +
  '      - name: Checkout target ref for read-only verification\n' +
  '        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n' +
  '        with:\n' +
  '          ref: ${{ inputs.target_ref }}\n' +
  '          path: workspace\n' +
  '          persist-credentials: false\n' +
  '          # Source ancestry evidence must include parents and reachable history;\n' +
  '          # depth-1 leaves only the commit SHA in .git/shallow and makes\n' +
  '          # exact-source merge/parent proofs incorrectly Pending.\n' +
  '          fetch-depth: 0\n' +
  '\n' +
  '      - name: Checkout immutable authenticated Provider evidence\n' +
  "        if: inputs.provider_source_run_id != '' || (inputs.stage == 'post-merge' && (inputs.issue_number == 1749 || inputs.issue_number == 2817))\n" +
  '        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n' +
  '        with:\n' +
  '          ref: metrics\n' +
  '          path: provider-metrics\n' +
  '          persist-credentials: false\n' +
  '\n' +
  '      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4\n' +
  '        with:\n' +
  "          node-version: '24'\n" +
  '\n' +
  '      - name: Self-test trusted Acceptance tooling\n' +
  '        working-directory: trusted\n' +
  '        run: |\n' +
  '          ./gates/run requirement-acceptance-selftest acceptance-executor-selftest acceptance-agent-selftest acceptance-ci-evidence-selftest\n' +
  '\n' +
  '      - name: Validate invocation\n' +
  '        run: |\n' +
  '          set -euo pipefail\n' +
  '          if ! [[ "${ISSUE_NUMBER}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || [[ "${ISSUE_NUMBER}" -le 0 ]]; then\n' +
  '            echo "Invalid issue number: ${ISSUE_NUMBER}" >&2\n' +
  '            exit 1\n' +
  '          fi\n' +
  '          case "${ACCEPTANCE_STAGE}" in\n' +
  '            pre-merge|staging|post-merge) ;;\n' +
  '            *) echo "Unsupported acceptance stage: ${ACCEPTANCE_STAGE}" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n' +
  '          esac\n' +
  '          case "${ACCEPTANCE_PROVIDER}" in\n' +
  '            cursor|deepseek|qwen) ;;\n' +
  '            *) echo "Unsupported Acceptance provider: ${ACCEPTANCE_PROVIDER}" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n' +
  '          esac\n' +
  '\n' +
  '      # PR-stage CI readback remains exceptional: #2917 has bounded timing\n' +
  '      # evidence and #3001 independently proves its original Qwen implementing\n' +
  '      # PR and Reviewer against pinned GitHub/Store source. Trusted Main owns\n' +
  '      # both collectors; other PR-stage SCs have no GitHub evidence cost.\n' +
  '      - name: Collect trusted GitHub Actions evidence\n' +
  "        if: inputs.stage != 'pre-merge' || (inputs.stage == 'pre-merge' && (inputs.issue_number == '2917' || inputs.issue_number == '3001'))\n" +
  '        working-directory: trusted\n' +
  '        env:\n' +
  '          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}\n' +
  '          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}\n' +
  '        run: |\n' +
  '          set -euo pipefail\n' +
  '          if [[ "${ACCEPTANCE_STAGE}" == "pre-merge" ]]; then\n' +
  '            case "${ISSUE_NUMBER}" in\n' +
  '              2917) node scripts/acceptance-ci-evidence.mjs collect-pr-quality \\\n' +
  '                "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/workspace" \\\n' +
  '                "${RUNNER_TEMP}/acceptance-ci-evidence.json" ;;\n' +
  '              3001) node scripts/acceptance-ci-evidence.mjs collect-pr-fixture \\\n' +
  '                "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/workspace" \\\n' +
  '                "${RUNNER_TEMP}/acceptance-ci-evidence.json" ;;\n' +
  '              *) echo "Unsupported PR-stage collector Issue: ${ISSUE_NUMBER}" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n' +
  '            esac\n' +
  '          else\n' +
  '            node scripts/acceptance-ci-evidence.mjs collect \\\n' +
  '              "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/workspace" \\\n' +
  '              "${RUNNER_TEMP}/acceptance-ci-evidence.json"\n' +
  '          fi\n' +
  '\n' +
  '      - name: Prepare stage-specific immutable acceptance context\n' +
  '        id: prepare\n' +
  '        working-directory: trusted\n' +
  '        env:\n' +
  '          ACCEPTANCE_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}\n' +
  '          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}\n' +
  '          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}\n' +
  '        run: |\n' +
  '          set -euo pipefail\n' +
